In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a '''battle''' took place on the [[Atoan tar-pit planet]], in the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]], between forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], and [[Atoan]] defenders.
